prompt:
The newsletter section in sections/newsletter-signup.liquid currently renders every heading and paragraph block in order, followed by a form. It ignores the submission status and the message settings that already exist in its schema. Rewrite the markup to follow the rules below. Keep the {% schema %} block exactly as it is, byte for byte. Inputs (only these are supplied): - newsletter_status: top-level variable (NOT under section), string or null. Matching is exact and case-sensitive: only "success" and "error" have meaning. Any other value, or null, means idle. - section.settings.button_label: string or null. - section.settings.success_message: string or null. - section.settings.error_message: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each element has the form {"type": "heading" or "paragraph", "settings": {"text": string or null}}. The text key is always present. Rules: 1. All text values are stripped of leading and trailing whitespace. A null value counts as an empty string. 2. Heading: find the first block of type "heading" whose stripped text is non-empty. If one exists, output

TEXT

. It always appears as the first element inside the wrapper div, regardless of the block's position. All other heading blocks are ignored. If none exists, no h2 is output. 3. When newsletter_status is "success", output exactly:
[heading]

MSG

MSG is the stripped success_message, or "Thanks for subscribing!" when it is empty. Paragraphs and the form are NOT output in this state. 4. Otherwise, output
, followed by these parts in order: - [heading] - One

TEXT

for each "paragraph" block with non-empty stripped text, in block order. Paragraphs with empty text are skipped. - Only when newsletter_status is "error":

ERR

. ERR is the stripped error_message, or "Please enter a valid email address." when it is empty. -
. LABEL is the stripped button_label, or "Subscribe" when it is empty. -
5. Every text value (heading, paragraphs, messages, label) is HTML-escaped with the escape filter after stripping and defaulting. 6. Output contains no whitespace or newlines between or around tags. Nothing is output after the closing , including no trailing newline before the schema block. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/newsletter-signup.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
